purpose: Package and validate the existing frozen-feedback development benchmark as a replaceable-policy environment; no new scientific method experiment.
baseline: clean-ranking-v1 corrected_tournament, frozen original C0 policy
population: Exactly the clean-ranking-v1 850 jobs / 425 pools / 26 previously inspected development tasks, including small pools and Petfinder.
policy_interface: decide(observation) -> compare(pair) or stop; selection uses the frozen win-rate/evidence-count aggregator.
isolation: New OS-sandboxed Python process for each episode; allowlisted runtime and staging directory, no network, no project data reads/writes; CPU/time/attempt/output limits enforced by trusted host.
failure_rule: Policy episode failures remain in planned denominator with regret penalty 1 and hit 0; report failure count and valid-only metrics separately.
acceptance: Frozen sources and selected inputs match existing locks
Full baseline replay matches every existing corrected_tournament decision and macro metric
Provided random-query example matches the existing random_pairs control
Independent evaluation reconstructs feedback, budgets and selection before reading utilities
Label/file/network/write probes are blocked by OS sandbox
New baseline and example outputs preserve all prior clean-ranking artifacts
scope: Offline development environment only. New-task confirmation and full live-API/AI Scientist integration are separate acceptance stages.
